fixed.member: fantasy, scifi and cartoon style packs
fixed.summary: Text holds 4.5:1 in more places under each pack. Scifi's dark frost is denser (about 96 %), so a panel's ink, the muted ink too, reads over a white sky while the blurred scene still glows through. Fantasy's light scheme gets parchment-deep trend, XP and legendary inks and a deeper brass button ink, and its dark selected row a deeper brass under its labels. Cartoon's light selection and legendary ink read under their inks. Under fantasy and cartoon, a name's dark drop shadow stays in the dark scheme.
